name: Pennsylvania

rule.hpNote: motor greater than 25 hp (PWC: every operator, any age)
rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1982 needs a Boating Safety Education Certificate to run a boat with a motor over 25 hp, and every PWC operator needs one whatever their age.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1982 o después necesita el certificado de educación en seguridad náutica para manejar una embarcación con motor de más de 25 hp, y todo operador de moto acuática lo necesita sin importar su edad.

minAge.note: No one 11 or younger may run a boat over 25 hp or a PWC. PWC operators 12-15 may not carry passengers 15 or younger or rent a PWC; rented PWCs need an operator 16+.

exemptions: Boats with motors of 25 hp or less (not PWC).
People born before Jan. 1, 1982 (motorboats only; PWC operators always need the certificate).

card.feeNote: Permanent certificate fee $10 (included in online course fees); course fees may be extra. Temporary certificate valid 60 days. Duplicates via HuntFish.PA.gov.

nonResident: Visitors need a certificate from a NASBLA-approved course; Pennsylvania residents need a PFBC-issued certificate.
rental: PWCs may not be rented to anyone 15 or younger; rental businesses must give customers a safety orientation.
pwcExtra: No PWC operation at 11 or younger; ages 12-15 cannot carry passengers 15 or younger; no PWC between sunset and sunrise.

sources.quote: For persons born on or after January 1, 1982, to operate boats powered by motors greater than 25 horsepower.
To operate a personal watercraft, like a jet ski.
